description: Unit parsing and quantity conversion (measure contract section 3.1 and 3.2). parse: the text, expect the unit code or UNIT_UNKNOWN. convert: every ordered pair of units within each dimension for several values; round12 is value.to(unit, 12, HALF_EVEN) as plain text, exact is toExact (an error CONVERSION_INEXACT where the result does not terminate). arithmetic: plus, minus and compare between quantities; expect a quantity object or a number for compare.
howToRun: Parse value and unit codes; compute to(to, 12, HALF_EVEN) and toExact(to); compare plain text with round12 and exact (or the error code with exactError).
